title: fix(driver-sql): boot converges legacy text booleans on SQLite to 1 / 0
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg2evNa1V3zxrQq3KX

Closes #34973

Clause-②: yes (widening: `@objectstack/driver-sql` exports `PendingSchemaWorkKind` from its index, and the CLI consumes it, so the union gains one published value, `normalize_boolean_storage`; boolean filters, sorts and groupBy on SQLite now answer legacy text rows as their boolean)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：SQLite 上布尔/开关字段里旧版本留下的文本 `'true'` / `'false'`，启动时的 schema sync 会把它们改写成 `1` / `0`（第四个存储收敛步骤，和 datetime、time、JSON 回填并列）；`os migrate plan` 会把这一步列成 `normalize_boolean_storage` 并给出行数。
- **为什么改**：这些旧行读出来是对的布尔值，但筛选 `= false`、`$in`、`!=`、`$nin`、排序和分组都拿原始文本去比，结果漏行或分错组（文本 `'false'` 在分组里显示成 true）。
- **风险与回滚**：每列一条带守卫的 `UPDATE`，只改这两个文本拼法，其他文本只计数和告警、绝不改写；第二次启动改写 0 行。没有回滚步骤，因为改写后语义不变，撤回只会恢复有缺陷的形态；回滚代码即可停止该步骤，已改写的行无需还原。
- **先看**：`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`（`backfillCanonicalBooleans` 的计数/采样/UPDATE 与 `previewBooleanConvergence`）、`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-rotation.ts`（`initObjects` 里新增的一次调用）、`packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts`（摘要行措辞）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-34916-boolean-text-read.test.ts`，预期 23 个测试全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（L1-d 后由席位做 L2 契约复审）。

## Premise (measured, wider than filed)

Measured on `origin/main` `4443014630c` in the premise report on #34973 and restated in the claim amendment; nothing here goes beyond those measurements.

- Only SQLite can hold text booleans, and only as `'true'` / `'false'`: the column's NUMERIC affinity folds the text `'1'` / `'0'` into integers and keeps `'true'` / `'false'` as TEXT. Postgres, MSSQL, MySQL and Oracle coerce or refuse the text (code reading; no rig in this container).
- The card named `=` only. On those rows `=`, `$in`, `!=` and `$nin` all answer wrongly at the driver, the engine and the REST door; ORDER BY sorts them after every integer; aggregate groupBy presents a text `'false'` as true.
- The engine cannot address the rows (a read presents them as booleans, and a `'false'` comparand narrows to `false`), so the fix is raw SQL in the driver.

## What changes

- `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`: `backfillCanonicalBooleans`, the fourth driver storage convergence. SQLite only, for an existing table's scalar `Field.boolean` / `Field.toggle` columns. Per column: one counting scan over the column's text cells sorts them into legacy `'true'` / `'false'` and other text. Only when the scan finds legacy text does the step take an id sample (up to 5) and run ONE `UPDATE … set col = case col when 'true' then 1 when 'false' then 0 end where typeof(col) = 'text' and col in ('true', 'false')`. The count, the sample, the `UPDATE` and the preview all read one shared predicate (`SQLITE_LEGACY_BOOLEAN_TEXT`). Failures are logged at `warn` and swallowed, the same as the sibling backfills, so the next boot tries again.
- `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`: `previewBooleanConvergence`, called from `previewDeferredSchemaWork`. It counts the same predicate and reports `{ kind: 'normalize_boolean_storage', columns, rows }`.
- `sql-driver-rotation.ts`: one call beside the datetime, time and JSON backfills in `initObjects`, plus the host `Pick`. `sql-driver.ts`: the two host stubs (pointer docblocks only, because the facade sits under its line ceiling).
- `schema-drift.ts`: `PendingSchemaWorkKind` gains `normalize_boolean_storage`, which counts as in place under the existing `isInPlaceSchemaWork` rule.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts`: the `os migrate plan` / `apply` summary read `N temporal column(s) to converge in place`, so with this change a boolean column would have been counted as temporal. It now reads `N column(s) to converge in place`. The amendment expected no CLI change, because the renderer itself is generic, and it is; the summary label was the one word that would have become false.
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`: one example line and one paragraph for the new kind. A root changeset (driver-sql and cli, patch).

## Record and reversibility

The seat ruling (22:57Z), quoted from the claim amendment:

> route (a) is approved. backfillCanonicalBooleans becomes the fourth driver storage convergence, beside the datetime, time and JSON backfills: one guarded idempotent UPDATE per column, normalize_boolean_storage previewed under deferred DDL, non-canonical text withheld and warned. (1) Record: follow the convention, a count plus a capped id sample with no down step. Your reason holds, since an undo would only restore the broken form.

- **Record:** for each table and field that changed, one `info` line with `{ table, field, rowsConverted, sampleIds }`, with at most 5 ids.
- **No down step:** since #34965 a text row reads as its integer, so the rewrite keeps the meaning, and an undo would only bring back the form the filters miss.
- **Withheld:** other text (`'TRUE'`, `'yes'`) is never rewritten. It is counted and logged at `warn` as `{ table, field, rowsWithheld }`.
- **Atomicity:** each column is one atomic `UPDATE` on SQLite.

## Dry-run path

- `os migrate plan` (deferred DDL) lists the step in place as `normalize_boolean_storage: COLUMNS — N row update(s)` and writes nothing. The count is the one the step would convert, never the withheld rows.
- `os migrate apply` runs it after the confirmation, via the flush, which calls `initObjects`.
- An ordinary boot runs it automatically. `OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1` skips it, because that boot takes the DDL-free `registerObjectMetadata` door (`registerSchemasWithoutDdl` in the objectql plugin), which reaches no backfill.

## Pins and ablations

The pins live in `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-34916-boolean-text-read.test.ts` (three `[#34973]` describes) and `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.pending-render.test.ts`.

| Pin | Ablation A: backfill call removed | Ablation B: preview wiring removed |
|---|---|---|
| before the step, `= false` / `= true` miss the text rows | green (measures the defect) | green |
| after `initObjects`, `=` finds them (toggle too) | **red** | green |
| `$in`, `$ne`, `$nin`: wrong before, right after | **red** | green |
| ORDER BY: text after integers before, sorted with its boolean after | **red** | green |
| aggregate groupBy: 5 groups (text `'false'` as true) before, 3 after | **red** | green |
| `info` record: `rowsConverted` + `sampleIds` per field | **red** | green |
| second boot: first boot converted, second sends no converting UPDATE and logs nothing | **red** | green |
| `skipSchemaSync` (`registerObjectMetadata`) leaves the text rows untouched | green (by design) | green |
| other text withheld, warned once with the count | **red** | green |
| plan counts only the convertible rows, never the withheld | green | **red** |
| plan previews `normalize_boolean_storage` with its count, in place, and writes nothing | green | **red** |
| apply (flush) converges, and a re-plan finds none | **red** | green |
| CLI renders `deal [normalize_boolean_storage: won — 3 row update(s)]` in place | n/a | n/a |

Ablation C, CLI summary wording (`column(s)` put back to `temporal column(s)`): `summarizePendingSchemaWork … never omits in-place work` went **red** (`Expected: "6 column(s) to converge in place"`). The 12 other tests stayed green.

All three ablations went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, plus an outer EXIT/INT/TERM trap, and the tests import `src/` directly (no `dist/`, so no rebuild leg). Each one was restored by blob:

## Tests

All readings from the worktree `objectstack-issue-34973`, after merging `origin/main` `367e324eeb4` and rebuilding the cli closure (`turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/cli^...' --filter=@objectstack/cli`, 64/64 tasks).

- driver-sql pin file at `383a794b4fd`: `Tests 21 passed (21)`. `30bcd609ea0` touches only the cli test.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql typecheck && vitest run` at `383a794b4fd`: `Test Files 260 passed | 13 skipped (273)`, `Tests 4366 passed | 251 skipped (4617)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck && vitest run --project unit` at `383a794b4fd`: `Test Files 426 passed (426)`, `Tests 6057 passed (6057)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- At `30bcd609ea0`: cli `typecheck` exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`). The pending-render, lazy-driver-import and tier-partition files: `Tests 38 passed (38)`.
- The cli `integration` layer is declared to CI: the diff touches no integration file and no spawn entry.

## Acceptance notes

- The `skipSchemaSync` pin works at the driver: it calls the door the objectql plugin uses for that boot (`registerObjectMetadata`), and does not boot the plugin. It stays green under ablation A by design.
- Postgres, MySQL, MSSQL and Oracle were not measured live (no rig here). That they cannot hold the text comes from code reading, recorded in the premise report.
- At every boot, a converged column costs one counting scan over its text cells. That is the same order of cost as the sibling datetime backfill's guard count.

## Verification

- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 109 families for 9 paths (merge base `367e324ee`). I ran all 109 at `30bcd609ea0`: 108 exit 0, and `check:type-check-debt` is **NOT MEASURED** (verify-lock queue-timeout, exit 99; the lock was held by another worktree's suite run). It was exit 0 at `383a794b4fd`, and `30bcd609ea0` adds only test imports. `--ran` reconciliation: 109 derived, 108 run, 1 UNRUN (that family). CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` carries it.
- `check:test-source-alias` was red at `383a794b4fd`: 7 guarded imports reached from the edited pending-render test. It is green at `30bcd609ea0`, after module-top side-effect imports were added (its printed remedy). The bare imports are no value imports, so the file stays in the `unit` tier.
- `check-governed-merges --branch` at `30bcd609ea0`: NOT governed, 0 of 9 paths, 511 changed lines (+502 / -9), under 3000.
- `overlap-check` at `30bcd609ea0`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` against `origin/main` and #35060, #34791 and #34717, which share `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` and merge cleanly.
- Dogfood battery: n/a. The title has no `!`, and the Clause-② arm is `(widening)`.

## Delta round (head `db8bdd734bd`, after seat L2 PASS 6966769750)

- `c26c7d7551a`, docs, folds seat should-fix 2: the closing sentence in `cli.mdx` now names all three in-place steps. It says only the MySQL widen is a table rebuild.
- `dcbecc37966` merges `origin/main` (K = 17). `overlap-check` gives `VERDICT clean exit 0` against `origin/main` and #35060, #34791 and #34717.
- `db8bdd734bd` folds seat nits 3, 4 and 5:
  - The withheld count excludes the canonical text `'1'` / `'0'` that a TEXT-affinity column stores.
  - `rowsConverted` falls back to the counted rows when a client's raw `UPDATE` reports no `changes` (driver-sqlite-wasm, knex `sqlite3`).
  - The `PendingSchemaWork.rows` docblock names `normalize_boolean_storage`.
- Two new pins:
  - **A TEXT-affinity column:** `'1'` / `'0'` are not withheld, and the legacy `'true'` still converges. Ablation 3 puts the withheld formula back to `text_rows - legacy`: `Tests 1 failed | 22 passed (23)`.
  - **A client with no `changes`:** the record carries the counted rows. Ablation 4 puts the fallback back to `0`: `Tests 1 failed | 22 passed (23)`.
  - Each ablation was restored by copying the file back.
- Readings at `db8bdd734bd`: the pin file shows `Tests 23 passed (23)`, and driver-sql `tsc --noEmit` exits 0. The full driver-sql suite was not re-run locally; CI's Test Core carries it.
- Reviews: L1 delta ACCEPT 6966877056, and the seat delta L2 PASS 6967050006 carries the PASS forward. Seat should-fix 1 (the Turso remote face) went to triage as a follow-up.
